summary.value: The Manhattan at Times Square Hotel now trades as Crowne Plaza Manhattan Times Square - formerly The Manhattan at Times Square, in the heart of Midtown. Its strength is position: Trip.com guests say “The location of the hotel is great and right in the middle of it all”. But it scores 6.4 / 10 245 reviews, and honest watch-outs include “There was constant, loud renovation noise from upstairs next door” and “The room's hygiene was terrible”, so pick it only at a strong rate.

description.value: The Manhattan at Times Square Hotel has been rebranded. Times Square Alliance lists it as Crowne Plaza Manhattan Times Square - formerly The Manhattan at Times Square. Book under the new Crowne Plaza name, and confirm room types and rates directly with IHG. Trip.com shows 6.4 / 10 245 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “The location of the hotel is great and right in the middle of it all”. Representative watch-outs: “There was constant, loud renovation noise from upstairs next door”; “The room's hygiene was terrible”.
